title: The server saves its workspaces and restores them at start
body:
A session should mostly survive a reboot. Today nothing about the layout is saved.

## Proposal

The server saves each workspace's layout, its panes' labels and cwds after changes, before a pane exits and at shutdown. At start it restores them. Terminal panes restart in their cwd, and GUI panes come back empty, with a way to relaunch them to follow later. The saved file is an on-disk format with a version byte under CLAUDE.md.

decade-cc25be, what replaces anchors and pinning, needs settling before this, because it decides what a saved pane holds.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/6b9cbed5
notes.text: decade-cc25be is decided. A saved pane holds a name, a command or a plain shell, and a cwd. GUI apps are not relaunched, which is decade-15e5eb. Whether a GUI pane comes back as an empty slot is open here.
